description: This file initializes and manages build settings for cross-platform input in Unity, including enabling/disabling mobile input and setting compiler defines based on build target.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInitialize
classes.description: A class that initializes build defines and provides menu options to enable or disable mobile input in Unity editor.

methods.name: CrossPlatformInitialize
methods.description: Static constructor that sets default defines if not already set.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables mobile input and shows a dialog based on the current build target.

methods.name: EnableValidate
methods.description: Validates if mobile input can be enabled based on current defines.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Disables mobile input and shows a confirmation dialog.

methods.name: DisableValidate
methods.description: Validates if mobile input can be disabled based on current defines.

methods.name: SetEnabled
methods.description: Adds or removes compiler defines for specified build target groups.

methods.name: GetDefinesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of current scripting define symbols for a build target group.
